/api/galaxy/{name}/research.summary: A player's technology tree, read by a referee
/api/galaxy/{name}/research.description: A player's tree, read by a referee. Same payload as GET /api/technologies -- the same function builds it, and a referee reading anything else would be refereeing something else -- plus who it belongs to (player), whether it is read as a referee (moderating), and whether one may pick another (can_moderate). The body may carry `player`; without it, it is one's own tree and the route does no more than the ordinary read. POST so the player's name travels in the body rather than through a proxy's access log.

200.description: The player's state in the tree

403.description: Moderation of this galaxy is required

404.description: Galaxy or player does not exists

/api/galaxy/{name}/research/grant.summary: Place or take back research levels, instantly and for free
/api/galaxy/{name}/research/grant.description: Place or take back research levels, instantly and for free. The counterpart of /api/territory/<id>/grant for what hangs on no world. Nothing is charged, no slot is taken, no prerequisite is required -- a referee who had to climb a whole branch to hand out its summit would never repair anything. What still holds is the node's CEILING: a level beyond its maximum exists in no effect table. Body: player, name (the node), a signed amount, and choice for a doctrine. Brought back to zero, a doctrine returns its way to the player. Restricted to a moderator of this galaxy, and the player must hold something in it -- research follows a player across every galaxy, so the right to touch it must be anchored where he actually plays. Writes a moderation.grant line.

200.description: The player's whole tree, after the gesture

400.description: Zero or oversized amount, missing player, or a player who holds nothing here
